escenas.texto: We toured Oceania, Asia, Africa, Europe and the Americas. Now, the ranking that brings it all together: this week's global Top 10. This week in the World, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over seven hundred and fifty-one million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, the World edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The world rules: the top three of every list from every continent compete here, the same videos and the same numbers from this Sunday's world tour. One video per creator on each list. Every number comes from the official YouTube API. Let's go.
Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Number ten, from India, Ashutosh Kumar, with a video posted five days ago. Over sixteen million views. It also has over sixteen thousand comments.
Coming in at number nine, from Australia, Odd Tilt, with “How you invented blinds!”. Over eighteen million views. A Short of just thirty-four seconds. It also has over nine thousand comments.
At number eight, Calm man , with “The fight between the two couples.”. Over twenty-one million views. It also has one hundred and forty-one comments.

Next up, number seven, Silly AI Lab, with a video posted four days ago. Over twenty-one million views. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-one seconds.
Next up, number six, from Japan, MY💝No War🤝, with “Wait all the cokes erupt at once?!”. Over twenty-eight million views. A Short of just twenty-four seconds. It also has over three thousand comments.

At number five, Bipoumi, with “Comment ALARM if you want your kids to stay safe!”. Over thirty-three million views. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-two thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eleven seconds.

Number four, from India, Samay Raina, with “INDIA’S GOT LATENT S2 EP9 ft. Raftaar, Balraj Ghai, Sahil Kale”. Over thirty-seven million views. A video over fifty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over twenty-one thousand comments.

Bronze medal, from Brazil, Gabrielmiranda_ofc, with a video posted six days ago. Over forty-nine million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A Short of just forty-five seconds.

Silver medal, from Brazil, Universo Labz, with a video posted four days ago. Over sixty-eight million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about six hundred and ten thousand views per hour. A Short of just thirty-three seconds.

And finally, number one most viewed, from United States, Oddly Wally, with “She Moved Her Seat. He Kept Eating.”. Over eighty million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and ten thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifty-seven seconds.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Next up, number ten, from Spain, Tecnonauta, with a video posted four days ago. Over eleven thousand comments. It also has over one point five million views.
In position number nine, from Australia, GLITCH, with “Glitch productions all bosses no damage”. Over eleven thousand comments. It also has over four point five million views.

In position number eight, from Canada, ENDYMIONtv, with “Sony BLOCKS GTA6 Refunds as No Disc Disaster Goes Nuclear”. Over eleven thousand comments. A video over twenty-five minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.

Number seven, from United Kingdom, Sidemen, with “Sidemen murder mystery dinner”. Over twelve thousand comments. A video over one hundred and twelve minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

Coming in at number six, from Türkiye, Remzi Kamalak, with a video posted six days ago. Over twelve thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: nine out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over forty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Number five, from United States, Pubity, with “Johnny Depp says he believes in goats”. Over twelve thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about thirty-two thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just nineteen seconds.

Next up, number four, from India, Samay Raina, with “INDIA’S GOT LATENT S2 EP9 ft. Raftaar, Balraj Ghai, Sahil Kale”. Over twenty-one thousand comments. A video over fifty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over thirty-seven million views.

Bronze medal, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “We bought the most expensive house gta 5 gameplay”. Over twenty-seven thousand comments. A video over one hundred and fourteen minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.

Silver medal, from India, ProBoiz 95, with “Darkheroes: sheng has arrived!! season 4 episode 1”. Over twenty-eight thousand comments. A video over sixty-one minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over four point seven million views.

Drum roll, please. Number one most commented, from Mexico, Fede Vigevani, with a video posted one day ago. Over seventy-eight thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about seven hundred thousand views per hour. A video over twenty-four minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. At number ten, from Austria, Red Bull, with “No, You Couldn't Do This”. Over two hundred and sixty-nine thousand likes. It also has over nine point four million views.

At number nine, Greg Batocabe, with “bros hair is a whip”. Over two hundred and eighty-one thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about seventy-one thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eighteen seconds.
In position number eight, Combatful, with a video posted four days ago. Over two hundred and eighty-three thousand likes. A Short of just fifty seconds. It also has over five point six million views.

Coming in at number seven, from Australia, Odd Tilt, with “How you invented blinds!”. Over four hundred and thirty-eight thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-four seconds. It also has over eighteen million views.
In position number six, from India, Ashutosh Kumar, with a video posted five days ago. Over four hundred and sixty-five thousand likes. It also has over sixteen million views.
In position number five, from India, FactoHolic, with a video posted five days ago. Over six hundred and seventy thousand likes. It also has over thirteen million views.

In position number four, from United States, Oddly Wally, with “She Moved Her Seat. He Kept Eating.”. Over six hundred and seventy-nine thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and ten thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just fifty-seven seconds.

Bronze medal, from India, Samay Raina, with “INDIA’S GOT LATENT S2 EP9 ft. Raftaar, Balraj Ghai, Sahil Kale”. Over nine hundred and thirty-six thousand likes. A video over fifty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over thirty-seven million views.

Silver medal, from Mexico, Fede Vigevani, with a video posted one day ago. Over one million likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about seven hundred thousand views per hour. A video over twenty-four minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

And here it is. Number one most liked, from Brazil, Gabrielmiranda_ofc, with a video posted six days ago. Over two point six million likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A Short of just forty-five seconds.

And that wraps up this week's world tour. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
